run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the starting index of the maximum average subarray of length k
test_f_gold: test f_gold with arrays of integers and subarray length k to verify correct index
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a sliding window sum instead of cumulative sum array
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like k greater than array length returning negative one
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the start index of the subarray with maximum average using cumulative sums
